def train_probe_swe_conf2():
    """Train GRU probe on SWE conf>=2 E5-large embeddings."""
    print("\n=== Step 2: Training GRU probe on SWE conf>=2 ===")
    set_seed(SEED)

    data = torch.load(SWE_EMB_PATH, weights_only=False, map_location="cpu")
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    instance_ids = data["instance_ids"]
    confidences = data.get("confidences", [1] * len(labels))
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]

    keep = [i for i, c in enumerate(confidences) if c >= 2]
    print(f"Confidence filter: {len(keep)}/{len(labels)} windows with conf>=2")

    embeddings = [embeddings[i] for i in keep]
    labels = [labels[i] for i in keep]
    instance_ids = [instance_ids[i] for i in keep]

    train_idx, val_idx, test_idx = split_by_instance(instance_ids, seed=SEED)

    def make_dataset(indices):
        return WindowDataset([embeddings[i] for i in indices], [labels[i] for i in indices])

    train_ds = make_dataset(train_idx)
    val_ds = make_dataset(val_idx)

    train_labels = [labels[i] for i in train_idx]
    num_pos = sum(train_labels)
    num_neg = len(train_labels) - num_pos
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)]).to(DEVICE)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)} (pos={num_pos}, neg={num_neg})")
    print(f"Val: {len(val_ds)}, Test: {len(test_idx)}")
    print(f"pos_weight: {pos_weight.item():.3f}")

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=32, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=embed_dim, hidden_size=256, num_layers=2, dropout=0.1).to(DEVICE)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=0.01)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)

    best_f1 = 0.0
    patience = 5
    patience_counter = 0
    history = []

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for epoch in range(1, 21):
        model.train()
        total_loss, n_samples = 0.0, 0
        for padded, batch_labels, lengths in train_loader:
            padded = padded.to(DEVICE)
            batch_labels = batch_labels.to(DEVICE)
            logits = model(padded, lengths)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()
            total_loss += loss.item() * len(batch_labels)
            n_samples += len(batch_labels)

        avg_loss = total_loss / n_samples

        model.eval()
        all_labels, all_preds = [], []
        with torch.no_grad():
            for padded, batch_labels, lengths in val_loader:
                logits = model(padded.to(DEVICE), lengths)

                all_labels.extend(batch_labels.long().tolist())
                all_preds.extend(preds.tolist())

        val_metrics = compute_metrics(all_labels, all_preds)
        record = {"epoch": epoch, "train_loss": avg_loss, **{f"val_{k}": v for k, v in val_metrics.items()}}
        history.append(record)

        is_best = val_metrics["macro_f1"] > best_f1
        if is_best:
            best_f1 = val_metrics["macro_f1"]
            patience_counter = 0
            torch.save({
                "model_state_dict": model.state_dict(),
                "embed_dim": embed_dim,
                "hidden_size": 256,
                "num_layers": 2,
                "dropout": 0.1,
                "epoch": epoch,
                "val_macro_f1": best_f1,
            }, OUTPUT_DIR / "best_model.pt")
        else:
            patience_counter += 1

        marker = " *" if is_best else ""
        print(f"Epoch {epoch:2d} | loss={avg_loss:.4f} | val_F1={val_metrics['macro_f1']:.4f} acc={val_metrics['accuracy']:.4f}{marker}")

        if patience_counter >= patience:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}")
            break

    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "train_history.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(history, f, indent=2)

    # Save split info
    split_info = {
        "train_indices": train_idx,
        "val_indices": val_idx,
        "test_indices": test_idx,
        "seed": SEED,
        "embed_dim": embed_dim,
        "min_confidence": 2,
        "keep_indices": keep,
    }
    with open(OUTPUT_DIR / "split_info.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(split_info, f)

    print(f"\nBest val macro-F1: {best_f1:.4f}")
    return best_f1
